1.

In Christ Jesus we have received life, And all He has done well; How rich, how glorious is our portion, How fair our inheritance!

2.

We know the Father loves us, And long to apprehend more His love, which has “wholly apprehended” us, And gives us daily strength.

3.

We know we shall behold God In glory soon, And raise the sound of the song of victory, And see His glory clearly.

4.

Our Father! Teach our hearts only To know Thee better, To praise more for the grace we have received, And walk in Thy path.

5.

To the Son Thou didst choose a bride, In Him she is rich; His fair name, His robe we bear, Soon we shall be like Him.

6.

With joy shall she then praise Her Bridegroom’s faithfulness, With Him share the throne of glory, And eternal glory.

7.

Praise be to Thy mercy, That Thou hast ordained it thus, And praise be to Thee for ever, That we have seen it!
